relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.evidence: He majored in religion and sociology at Trinity College in Connecticut and graduated salutatorian in 1975

relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.evidence: He attended graduate school in religion at Yale University where his prize-winning dissertation formed the basis of his first book

relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.evidence: He taught at Fordham University at Lincoln Center from 1981 to 1988

relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.object: Harvard University and Harvard Divinity School
relations.role: chairman of the Committee on the Study of Religion
relations.evidence: and Harvard University and Harvard Divinity School from 2001 to 2007. At Harvard, he became chairman of the Committee on the Study of Religion.

relations.subject: Diana L. Eck
relations.evidence: His role of committee chair was taken by Diana L. Eck, who had previously chaired it between 1990 and 1998.

relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.role: Grace Craddock Nagle Chair of Catholic Studies
relations.evidence: Orsi then gained a chaired position in religious studies with a joint appointment in history at Northwestern University. There, he is the Grace Craddock Nagle Chair of Catholic Studies.

relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.evidence: From 2020 to 2021, he was a Faculty Fellow at the University of Notre Dame.

relations.subject: Christine Helmer
relations.evidence: Orsi's wife was also offered a position at Northwestern, as a full professor in religion with a joint appointment in German.

relations.subject: Robert Anthony Orsi
relations.evidence: He attributed this decision to the fact that the Divinity School had not offered a faculty position to his wife, Christine Helmer.
